premise: After being publicly abandoned at the altar for her cruel sister, an outcast noblewoman accepts the sudden proposal of a scarred, mysterious war veteran who is secretly the rightful duke in hiding.

characters.name: Juliana
characters.role: Disowned noblewoman and skilled herbalist betrayed at the altar

characters.name: Alexander
characters.role: Scarred war veteran living in exile, secretly the rightful Duke of Ashburn

characters.name: Catherine
characters.role: Scheming noblewoman allied with Rupert to seize the Ashbury dukedom

characters.name: Rupert
characters.role: Traitorous usurper who stole Alexander's ducal seat

characters.name: Gerald Harrington
characters.role: Juliana's dishonorable ex-fiancé who abandons her at the altar

characters.name: Clarissa
characters.role: Juliana's spiteful sister who steals Gerald

characters.name: Dowager Duchess
characters.role: Alexander's captive mother, secretly poisoned with arsenic by the usurpers

characters.name: Prudence
characters.role: Manor maid who assists Juliana in treating the Dowager Duchess

characters.name: Father Thomas
characters.role: Corrupt clergyman engaged in a clandestine affair with Catherine

characters.name: Lord Sterling
characters.role: Conspiring aristocrat aiding Rupert's usurpation of the ducal seat

characters.name: High Priest
characters.role: Crown religious authority who challenges the validity of Juliana and Alexander's marriage

selling_reveals: Juliana is publicly discarded at the altar by Gerald, only for a mysterious scarred soldier to step forward and propose on the spot.
Juliana's impoverished, wounded cottage husband is in truth the presumed-dead rightful Duke of Ashburn.
Juliana infiltrates the grand estate as a scullery maid and cures the poisoned Dowager Duchess, who recognizes the Ashbourne ducal ring on Juliana's hand.

late_payoffs.what: Alexander's mother escapes captivity and reunites with her presumed-dead son
Alexander shatters the cathedral doors in full ducal regalia, reclaims his birthright, and halts Juliana's execution
Rupert and Lord Sterling are exposed for treason by Crown officials and arrested
Catherine is publicly rejected, stripped of her nobility, and demoted to a scullery maid under Juliana
